titulo_original: Principio de incendio sobre paisaje desierto

sinopsis.es: Un hombre muere al caer por una ventana. La mujer que se queda en la casa intenta entender qué ocurrió.
sinopsis.en: A woman lives secluded in her house, surrounded by the silences left by her partner's absence. Through architecture, memory, and carefully measured dream sequences, a mystery unfolds, slowly burning away.
